rationale: The papers 'Formation of Hot Jupiters through Secular Chaos and Dynamical Tides' (1901.05006) and 'Chaotic Tides in Migrating Gas Giants' (1812.05618) investigate the dynamical processes contributing to the formation and evolution of hot Jupiters, addressing aspects of the question regarding inclination and eccentricity distributions.
